texts.zh: 我们正在见证[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民迈出他们走向启蒙的第一步。他们向上抬头，对宇宙的奥秘始终抱持开放的态度。随着艺术表达在他们文化中的发展，艺术力量捕捉社会的精神奋斗的一面也在发展。他们渴望有某种高于自我的信仰。
texts.en: We are witnessing the inhabitants of [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] taking their first steps towards enlightenment. They look upwards, opening themselves to the mysteries of the universe. As artistic expression develops within their culture, so does art's power to capture the spiritual striving of their society. They yearn for something beyond themselves to believe in.

label.zh: 我们应当回应他们的祈祷！
一切都将化为尘土。剩下的只不过是这件事的序曲。
label.en: Everything turns to dust. The rest is merely prelude.

texts.zh: 通过向存在的神圣真理开放自己，[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民正在接近开悟。作为精神领袖，我们有责任引导他们。
texts.en: By opening themselves to the divine truth of existence, the inhabitants of [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] are approaching enlightenment. As spiritual leaders, it is our duty to guide them.

texts.zh: 当[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的居民仰望天空时，他们希望得到圣灵的赐福。然而，他们实际得到的是沉默。他们的祈祷没有得到回应。现在他们必须接受精神飘忽不定的本质。只有科学拥有他们寻求的答案。
texts.en: When the inhabitants of [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] looked up to the skies they hoped to receive blessings from the divine. What they actually received was silence. Their prayers have gone unanswered. Now they must accept the frivolous nature of spirituality. Only science holds the answers they seek.

# 旅程开始 / The Journey Begins

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_dlc_events.txt:2555-2745`；common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:140-201（每月观测事件池）；`events/first_contact_dlc_situation_events.txt:316-376`（preftl.50）

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 被观测的前超光速文明的“科技进步”局势每月有 5/100 的机会运行 preftl.50（之后 1800 天冷却），从每月观测事件池中按权重抽取一个条件满足的事件；本事件权重 100。“挣脱桎梏”帝国观测原母族时使用的专用事件池中也有本事件。
  The observed pre-FTL civilization's tech-progress situation has a 5/100 monthly chance to run preftl.50 (then an 1800-day cooldown), which draws one valid event from the monthly observation pool by weight; this event has weight 100. It is also in the separate pool used when a Broken Shackles empire observes its parent civilization.
- 条件：中世纪晚期或文艺复兴时代、被动观察（或游牧中继站观察者）；本事件或“无知会传染”已发生过则不再出现。
  Conditions: Late Medieval or Renaissance Age, Passive Observation (or nomad waystation); not if this event or "Ignorance is Contagious" already fired.
- 隐藏分派事件设置一次性标记，然后在 0–25 天后向观测哨站拥有者（及游牧中继站观察者）发出可见事件。
  The hidden dispatcher sets a once-only flag and sends the visible event to the observation post owner (and nomad waystation observers) after 0-25 days.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 1340「旅程开始」：他们仰望星空，渴望可以信仰的事物。
  1340 "The Journey Begins": they look upward, yearning for something to believe in.
- “知道了”；（唯心）“回应他们的祈祷！”→ 100 天后 1345「未来会如何？」；（唯物、非格式塔）“万物终归尘土”→ 100 天后 1350「一切皆往终结」。
  "Acknowledged"; (spiritualist) "answer their prayers!" → 100 days later 1345 "What Lies Ahead?"; (materialist, non-gestalt) "everything turns to dust" → 100 days later 1350 "All Paths Must End".

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 1345 与 1350 由不同思潮的选项引出，互斥。
  1345 and 1350 come from options of different ethics and are exclusive.
- 这是随机观测插曲：只在满足条件时可能出现，彼此之间没有固定顺序。
  This is a random observation interlude: it may appear only when its conditions hold, with no fixed order relative to other interludes.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 第二、三个选项分别要求唯心与唯物（非格式塔）。
  Options two and three require spiritualist and materialist (non-gestalt) ethics.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发（与 1355 互斥标记）、选项条件、100 天延迟。
  Checked: trigger (shared exclusion flag with 1355), option conditions, 100-day delays.
